description: This PHP source file defines the class `FormatWithSkill`, which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface in the context of OrangeHRM. The class provides functionality to format a value by retrieving a Skill entity via the SkillService and returning its name.

classes.name: FormatWithSkill
classes.description: A class implementing value formatting by fetching skill names based on skill IDs.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill object by ID and returns its name if available, otherwise null.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of SkillService.
